ask: this is a mess fix it
sentence: Each person in a group chat gets one veto to strike a restaurant from a fixed list of five until one place is left and wins.
use_when: a group can't agree on where to eat dinner
narrowing a short list of places by elimination
everyone should get an equal say with one strike each
picking a winner without a long discussion
dont_use_when: people need to vote for a favorite or rank choices
the list of options must be custom or change over time
a time or date needs to be picked, not a place
